description: Convert fuel economy between L/100km, km/L, miles per gallon (US and UK) and miles per litre. Enter a value once and see it in every unit instantly.

faqs.a: L/100km measures consumption (fuel per distance), while mpg and km/L measure economy (distance per fuel). Converting between the two uses division: 30 mpg (US) = 235.214583 ÷ 30 = 7.84 L/100km.

faqs.q: What is the difference between US and UK mpg?
faqs.a: The US gallon is 3.78541 L while the imperial gallon is 4.54609 L, so the same car shows a ~20% higher number in UK mpg.

faqs.q: What is a good L/100km figure?
faqs.a: Roughly: under 6 is excellent, 6–8 is good, 8–10 is average, and above 12 is thirsty for a passenger car.
